lastCompletedStory.title: Document --cycle-close and the exit-code contract in JOURNAL_HELP with a static help-text test

nextStoryContext: US-001 done: JOURNAL_HELP (index.ts, JOURNAL_HELP block ~line 345) now lists --cycle-close in the usage line and Options section, and the Behaviour body gained a non-restructuring appended 'Exit-code contract:' paragraph (exit 1 / exit 3 / exit 4) after the existing numbered items 1-8 (kept verbatim, per the story's 'extend, do not restructure' note). printFatalHint's usage string (index.ts ~line 1253) was kept in sync. Gotcha discovered and logged to patterns.md: renderHelp's NAME_COL_WIDTH (24 chars) padding silently disappears once a HelpEntry.name is >= 24 chars, so I reverted an attempted Subcommands-entry rename back to the original 'append [--force]' rather than ship a glitched render -- always eyeball `bun index.ts <cmd> --help` after editing a *_HELP block, not just the source diff. US-002 (next, priority 2) is a doc-only story on a DIFFERENT surface (.claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md + templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md, the exit-3 refuse-to-arm case next to the existing exit-4 note at line 339 of both copies) and requires bun run embed-vendor + embed-vendor:check since it touches templates/; it does not touch index.ts or JOURNAL_HELP at all, so there is no overlap with this story's diff.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal help-text/prose change (JOURNAL_HELP in index.ts) plus a new static test using the existing bun:test + process.stdout.write interception pattern already established by ISSUE_HELP's test. No external library API surface was touched.
